title: 11 Advanced function types: Visual Guide
outline: Title: 11 Advanced function types: Visual Guide

1. From Equation To Graph | the already-taught equation |x - 2| = 5 beside the function f(x) = |x - a| drawn as a two-branch V, with sliders for the centre a and the height c and the solution count live | an absolute value equation is the V-shaped piecewise function read at a fixed height, so a positive c gives two solutions symmetric about a, c = 0 gives one at the vertex, and a negative c gives none because a distance is never negative

2. Pick The Piece | three piecewise functions (|x| as two rules, a three-rule set with a curved middle piece, a step function with boundaries) graphed with a sliding input that lights up the active rule and traces the evaluation | evaluating piecewise is always choose-the-rule then substitute, the conditions must not overlap or an input would get two outputs, and boundary ownership follows which condition carries the equals sign

3. Inner Then Outer | four function pairs run through a two-box machine chain in both orders, with a draggable input, the intermediate value, and both symbolic forms | (f o g)(x) means f(g(x)) - g runs first even though it is written second, composition is neither addition nor multiplication, and the two orders usually differ, agreeing only when the functions undo each other

4. Domain Of The Chain | three composites (sqrt(x) after x-1, 1/x after x-3, 1/x after sqrt(x)) with a number line shading where the composite is defined and two gates opening or shutting as x slides | a composite is defined at x only if x is legal for the inner function AND g(x) is legal for the outer one, so the domain of sqrt(x) o (x-1) is x >= 1, not x >= 0 - the outer requirement must be translated back through the inner function

5. Round Trip Check | five candidate pairs (including 2x-1 with (x+1)/2 and with (x-1)/2, and x^2 with sqrt(x)) sent through both compositions f(g(x)) and g(f(x)) at a draggable input, each trip marked as returning x or not | two functions are inverses exactly when both round trips return x on suitable domains, one direction alone can pass falsely (sqrt(x^2) = |x| fails at negative x), and only a one-to-one function is invertible, which is what domain restrictions are for
